answer: My answer to sybils is Idena validation ceremony proof — a ceremony attended live by one human — which makes the zenith of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the basalt is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The hollow grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big. That is one wall; many such walls, each different, make a farm uneconomic.
